small.limits: One short serial closed-loop window/cell, 32B complete GET/CON, concurrency1. Python/GIL and independent authentication/byte validation included. No saturation or significance claim. Server scheduling differs: Coaptic spin, coap-rs two Tokio workers, aiocoap asyncio, codec narrower endpoint. CPU is quantized; client resource window includes context/socket setup+warmup, server window also includes driver process startup. Server CPU includes launcher+worker process tree; RSS sum includes shared pages more than once and per-process peak RSS covers lifetime. Client RSS and server tree RSS include runtime/dependencies, not core memory. OSCORE volatile only; no provisioning/persistence. No device involvement.

Initial16 DTLS traces retained Windows closed-client ICMP resets as capture failures; after the client-facing relay socket fix, a fresh16-case DTLS validation passed separately. strata.native: Seven servers; common independent Rust wire client. Coaptic bare and reusable UDP Apps; coap-lite is a narrower codec endpoint. Volatile/unprotected GET workload only.
strata.matched: Seven servers; common independent Python wire client with complete-byte validation. Bootstrap/warmup precede timing. Python/GIL limits belong to this stratum.
strata.oscore: Four native OSCORE endpoints: Coaptic bare/reusable, aiocoap and libcoap. Common independent aiocoap cryptography authenticates complete responses; replay32, one shared context.
strata.dtls: Four endpoints; common independent Go CoAP wire client over PionDTLS. Coaptic/coap-rs adapters are test-only. Per-session App ownership and runtime differ from UDP; setup handshakes precede timing.
strata.http3: quic-go HTTP/3 with verified fixture certificate and TLS1.3. Warm/cold connection cases; separate protocol/client, not a like-for-like CoAP encryption-cost control.
